reviews.reason: Checked the Penrose definition, the complete local existence/uniqueness proof, the SVD supplier, and the minimum-norm proof with its projection and image/kernel suppliers. The least-squares supplier proves that X+y is orthogonal to ker X and that every minimizer is X+y+z with z in ker X, so Pythagoras proves both directions of the unique minimum-norm characterization. Positive n,p require no full-rank or interpolation assumption and no AC. The Definition and page interface are unchanged. This is repair-author verification, not an independent review of the repair.
